jsdelivr.purpose: Load transit API provider definitions from the public-transport/transport-apis registry
jsdelivr.dataReceived: Provider configs with name, protocol type, coverage area (GeoJSON), endpoint URL, auth config, products

github.purpose: Fallback for loading transit registry when JSDelivr is unavailable
github.dataReceived: Same provider config JSON as JSDelivr

regional-operators.purpose: Regional public-transport journey-planning APIs auto-discovered from the public-transport/transport-apis registry (~85 operators across many countries). Queried only when no hand-crafted provider covers your area.
regional-operators.dataSent: Your journey query — origin/destination coordinates and/or stop IDs — forwarded server-side to the matched regional operator's API (HAFAS mgate or OpenTripPlanner). No account or device identifier is included.
regional-operators.dataReceived: Stops, departures, and journey itineraries for the requested trip.
